papers.title_en: PS-DLO: Property- and Spatially Aware Deformable Linear Object Manipulation Policy
papers.authors: Mengdi Li, Boxian Yao, Xiyu Zhu, Yifan Yang, Yunfan Lou, Xuan Han, Tao Liu, Zhibo Pang
papers.evidence: 机器人策略结合感知与控制，在真实环境中操控可变形物体
papers.tldr: 可变形线状物体（DLO）因几何细长而难以精准定位，且操作响应受物理属性影响，令感知与控制相互耦合。PS-DLO先用图文对比学习从初始观测识别物体属性类别，再利用SAM3从未来观测提取掩码引导的空间特征，并蒸馏至动作专家。它在单臂与双臂平台的九项真实任务中取得68.9%的平均成功率，比最强基线高20个百分点；蝴蝶结解结的七种视觉偏移中六种优于基线。结果表明，显式属性先验结合未来空间监督可提升多任务操作效果及视觉变化下的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Deformable linear objects (DLO) pose a coupled perception and control challenge: their slender geometry makes precise localization difficult, while their deformations depend on object-specific physical properties. To address this challenge, we propose PS-DLO, a property- and spatially aware DLO manipulation policy. First, contrastive image-text learning maps the initial observation to categorical descriptions of DLO properties, providing explicit physical and structural priors for action generation. Second, SAM3 extracts mask-guided features from future observations, which are distilled into the policy's action expert to encode task-relevant DLO regions and their subsequent configurations. We evaluate PS-DLO on nine real-world tasks across single-arm and bimanual platforms, training a shared multi-task policy for each embodiment. PS-DLO achieves an average success rate of 68.9%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 20.0 percentage points. In generalization experiments, PS-DLO achieves higher success rates than the baseline in six of seven visual-shift conditions on butterfly-knot untying. These results demonstrate that combining object-property priors with future spatial supervision improves multi-task DLO manipulation and robustness to visual variation.

papers.title_en: ThinkLocoManip: A Whole-Body Control Agentic Harness for Legged Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Nuo Chen, Shizeng Zhang, Yujie Yang, Jinghong Wang, Zhenyang Qu, Xiao-Ming Wu, Yunfei Guo, Zhongwen Lu, Haojie Liu, Chunpeng Lu, Qiao Sun, Xueyi Zhang, Jiangwei Zhong
papers.evidence: 面向大规模环境中的腿式机器人移动操作与具身任务执行
papers.tldr: 腿式机器人在大规模环境中执行复杂长时程移动操作，现有直接生成动作或先规划后执行的方法较难适应变化并从错误中恢复。ThinkLocoManip采用交错式推理与行动，持续观察执行结果并调整策略，同时编排感知、导航、操作和运动工具，配合跨域协同技能与关键帧思考机制。真实机器人实验中，其成功率达到77%，超过最强先规划后执行基线的37.1%。研究表明，将运动纳入工具推理并支持过程恢复，有助于提升复杂任务的可靠执行能力。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose ThinkLocoManip, an agentic harness for legged loco-manipulation designed to tackle complex, long-horizon tasks in large-scale environments. Existing approaches typically follow either direct action generation or a plan-then-act paradigm, both of which can struggle with the generalization and error-recovery capabilities required for extended task execution. In contrast, ThinkLocoManip adopts an interleaved reasoning-and-acting paradigm, allowing the agent to continuously reason about its current state, execute actions, observe their outcomes, and adapt its strategy accordingly. Building on this paradigm, our agentic harness orchestrates a suite of specialized tools for perception, navigation, manipulation, and locomotion, enabling flexible composition of heterogeneous capabilities. Unlike existing robotic agentic harnesses, ThinkLocoManip explicitly incorporates locomotion as a tool domain for agent reasoning and execution. We further design a set of skills that explicitly account for both tool usage within each functional domain and coordination across domains, supporting effective execution of complex behaviors over long horizons. To tackle task failure during long-horizon interactions, we develop keyframe thinking mechanism to preserve critical execution context and support efficient error recovery. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that ThinkLocoManip substantially outperforms representative methods based on both direct action generation and plan-then-act paradigms across challenging long-horizon legged loco-manipulation tasks. Notably, ThinkLocoManip achieves a success rate of 77%, more than twice that of the strongest plan-then-act baseline (37.1%). Our experiments further validate the effectiveness of interleaved reasoning and acting, tool orchestration, and coordinated skill execution.

papers.title_en: SceneAgent: An Agentic Pipeline from 3D and 4D Captures to Simulation Environments
papers.authors: Luke Hollis, Tianxing Fan, Heng Yang
papers.evidence: 结合场景重建、物体分解与仿真，构建具身策略训练环境
papers.tldr: 视觉采集虽能保留场景细节，但转为可交互仿真环境仍需重建物体、估计物理属性并反复修正，动态场景尤为困难。SceneAgent以智能体流程串联分割、物理建模、部件拆解、关节与形变仿真，并借助模拟器视觉检查和修复，还可生成物体变体及示范。实验中，杂乱料箱重建的最佳1厘米F1达60.75%，高于SimFoundry的6.9%；三组动态场景的平均动态IoU由0.86%升至99.09%。该框架将静态与动态捕获转化为可交互环境，并展示多样交互和初步真实机器人策略迁移潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Visual captures provide detailed scene appearance, but converting them into interactive simulation environments requires object reconstruction, physical modeling, and correction of intermediate errors. We present SceneAgent, an agentic pipeline that coordinates these steps through simulator-based visual inspection and repair. The pipeline processes 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), photogrammetry, LiDAR captures, AI-generated 3DGS scenes, and 4D videos of dynamic scenes, and combines object segmentation, physical parameter estimation, part decomposition, articulation, and deformable simulation. To support policy learning, SceneAgent generates diverse object variants ("digital sisters") and scripted demonstrations. On a cluttered bin scene from GraspClutter6D, SceneAgent raises F1 at 1 cm for every coding agent with scorable outputs both with and without its skills, and its reconstructions are better than SimFoundry: all agent configurations exceed SimFoundry's F1 score, with a best of 60.75% versus 6.9%. On three dynamic scenes from 4DCodeBench, SceneAgent raises the mean dynamic IoU of Gemini 4 Argon from 0.86% to 99.09%. We further demonstrate diverse simulated interactions and preliminary policy transfer to a real robot.

papers.title_en: SwapBot: Tool-Centric Robot Manipulation via Interchangeable End-Effectors and Tactile Sensing
papers.authors: Yunchu Zhang, Ray Song, Junhan Jiao, Liyiming Ke, Yuchen Yang, Ruihan Gao, Emma Romig, Siddhartha Srinivasa, Yiyue Luo
papers.evidence: 直接研究机器人使用工具进行接触式物体操作
papers.tldr: 日常机器人任务往往需要切割、轻刷、翻面和摆放等不同工具操作，单一通用夹爪难以覆盖丰富的接触需求。SwapBot 采用固定机器人侧接口与低成本工具侧适配器，将家用工具改造成可快速自主更换的末端执行器，并集成触觉传感和遥操作示范采集。用户研究表明，它能缩短遥操作时间、降低操作者负担；触觉示范训练的策略在接触丰富技能上较仅用图像提升15至25个百分点成功率。研究表明，模块化且具触觉的工具为扩展机器人操作能力提供了实用途径。
papers.abstract_en: Robot manipulation in everyday environments inherently involves substantial tool usage. Seemingly simple household tasks, such as cooking pan-fried tofu, require forceful cutting, delicate brushing, and precise placement using different tools under contact-rich interaction. Thus, the ability to autonomously swap and use task-appropriate tools is important for tool-centric manipulation. We introduce SwapBot, a modular, tool-centric end effector system featuring low-cost adapters that quickly convert common household tools into robot end effectors. Rather than pursuing a single universal gripper, SwapBot adopts a unified design principle that combines a fixed robot-side coupling interface with low-cost, tool-side adapters, enabling compatibility with diverse tools, including articulated ones, and multiple robot platforms. Each adapter integrates compact tactile sensors, supports fast autonomous swapping, and interfaces with an intuitive teleoperation system for efficient demonstration collection. User studies show that, during teleoperation, SwapBot reduces task completion time and operator workload. Using collected demonstrations on the robot, we train imitation learning policies to successfully perform tool-centric tasks like cooking tofu, stirring salad, flipping meat. Our ablation study shows that using tactile-augmented demonstrations improves policy performance across contact-rich skills, increasing success rates by 15 to 25 percentage points over RGB-only policies. These results highlight modular, tactile-equipped tools as a practical and extensible pathway toward robust and capable robot manipulation. Project website https://personalrobotics.github.io/SwapBot.

papers.title_en: BudSplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting under a Rendering Budget
papers.authors: Muyu Xu, Fangneng Zhan, Yu Wei, Ling Shao, Shijian Lu
papers.evidence: 前馈式多视图三维重建并控制冗余高斯基元数量
papers.tldr: 前馈式三维高斯泼溅可由输入图像直接预测高斯，加速新视角合成；但多视图越密集，候选原语越多，重复观测区域的冗余会推高渲染开销。BudSplat面向有限原语预算，学习保留更有价值的高斯：先利用多层视觉令牌估计细节重要性，并将其融入体素融合。再结合渲染贡献与细节重要性剪枝，并在局部重新分配配额，避免冗余区域占用过多原语。RE10K、DL3DV和ACID实验显示，该方法在渲染质量与效率间取得良好折中，为高效扩展多视图前馈三维重建提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising alternative to per-scene optimization, enabling fast novel view synthesis by predicting Gaussian primitives directly from input images. However, it quickly faces a bottleneck of rendering efficiency while scaling from sparse to dense multi-view inputs, which offer more geometric constraints but produce a rapidly growing set of candidate Gaussians. Existing solutions cannot reliably distinguish redundant primitives, leading to many redundant primitives from repeatedly observed regions and increased rendering cost without much gain in visual quality. We propose BudSplat, a compact feed-forward 3DGS framework that learns to keep the most valuable Gaussians under a limited primitive count. BudSplat has two novel designs. The first is a detail-aware importance score that is extracted from multi-level visual tokens, providing an explicit cue for regions where pruning is likely to harm perceptual quality. The score can be injected into voxel fusion to preserve high-value local contributors during multi-view aggregation. The second is quality-aware Gaussian pruning that selects a compact set of primitives by jointly considering rendering contribution and detail importance. The quality-aware pruning enables local quota redistribution that helps avoid over-allocating primitives to large redundant regions. Experiments on RE10K, DL3DV, and ACID show that BudSplat achieves a favorable trade-off among rendering quality and efficiency.

papers.title_en: Seeing and Imagining as One: Unified Video Generation and 4D Perception for Embodied World Modeling
papers.authors: Haitang Feng, Zhuoman Liu, Zhennan Wang, Sheng Wang, Juelin Li, Chengzhi Zhao, Hexiang Wei, Lin Shao
papers.evidence: 联合预测深度、场景分割与未来视频以支持具身世界建模
papers.tldr: 具身世界模型既要生成可信的未来画面，也要理解场景几何、语义与运动，但传统方案常将生成和感知拆成不同模型与流程。GenSight以单一预训练视频扩散Transformer为基础，统一表示视频、深度、具身分割及相对首帧的二维光流，并通过轻量任务调制和联合速度预测训练。模型可多步生成未来视频及对齐的稠密预测，也可对观测视频单步执行稠密感知；在多机器人形态操作和人手交互数据上，两类任务均表现良好。该设计以共享时空表征促进跨模态一致性，并让感知利用视频生成所学先验，为具身建模提供统一框架。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied world models should not only imagine plausible futures, but also perceive the geometric, semantic, and motion structure of the evolving world. We present GenSight, a unified embodied world model that brings future video generation and dense perception into a single pretrained video diffusion transformer. GenSight uses a unified spatiotemporal representation for video, depth, embodiment segmentation, and first-frame-relative 2D flow. Built on a shared DiT backbone, GenSight uses lightweight task modulation to predict all modalities within the same architecture. All tasks are jointly optimized within a unified velocity prediction space. At inference, GenSight supports two complementary modes: multi-step future video generation with aligned dense predictions and single-step dense perception from an observed video. By unifying modality representation, model architecture, and prediction space, GenSight avoids separate modality-specific pipelines and couples appearance, geometry, semantics, and motion in a shared representation. It promotes cross-modal consistency and allows dense perception to benefit from the spatiotemporal priors learned through video generation. Trained on embodied manipulation data spanning multiple robot embodiments and human-hand interactions, GenSight demonstrates strong performance in both video generation and dense 4D perception, highlighting the effectiveness of unifying seeing and imagining for embodied world modeling.

papers.title_en: UniffordInteractor: Reasoning the Unified Affordance for Human and Multi-Object Interaction
papers.authors: Chen Su, Xingqun Qi, Xurui Hu, Bingkun Yang, Muyi Sun, Man Zhang, Zhenan Sun
papers.evidence: 通过统一可供性推理建模人与多个物体的长时交互
papers.tldr: 人体与物体交互生成已有进展，但现有方法多面向单个或固定物体，且忽视物体之间的接触情境，因此难以覆盖复杂多物体场景。UniffordInteractor采用“先推理、后交互”框架：先用微调的三维多模态大语言模型推断统一可供性，再按根部、身体、手部到物体的层级自回归生成交互。实验显示，该方法在人与多物体交互生成上优于现有先进方法。其贡献是将人—物与物—物关系纳入统一建模，支持更逼真且长时程的交互。
papers.abstract_en: Deriving plausible and dynamic Human Object Interaction (HOI) has gained tremendous progress in Embodied AI and Immersive AR/VR. While existing HOI methods have effectively explored human interaction with individual or fixed objects, they still show limitations in complex multi-object interaction scenes. Meanwhile, previous approaches focus more on the contact information held by human-object relation, overlooking the significance of the contact situation of various entities (i.e., object-object). To address these limitations, we propose UniffordInteractor, a Reasoning-then-Interacting framework that leverages unified affordance for realistic and long-horizon human and multi-object interaction modeling. At the reasoning stage, we devise a Unified Affordance Reasoner (UAR) that employs a fine-tuned 3D Multimodal Large Language Model for unified object-centric affordance prediction. At the interacting stage, we propose Hierarchical Interaction Generator (HIG), which formulates the interaction generation as a hierarchical (e.g., root to body to hand to objects) autoregressive prediction, conditioned on the obtained unified affordance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniffordInteractor surpasses SOTA counterparts in human and multi-object interaction generation.

papers.title_en: On Shaky Ground: Characterising Non-Rigid Base Effects in Mobile Manipulation
papers.authors: Zongyuan Zhang, Christopher Lehnert, Will N. Browne, Jonathan M. Roberts
papers.evidence: 研究移动机器人操纵和现实环境中的物理交互
papers.tldr: 移动操作机器人能扩展接触任务范围，但轻型底座会因运动和支撑柔顺性影响工件处的力与运动，持续接触下的影响仍缺乏充分刻画。研究以打磨为案例，结合探索性仿真和两种轻型无驱动轮式平台实验，同步测量接触力、工具运动与底座振动。在低底座—地面阻力下，100牛顿指令仅实现54%至70%，工具中心点误差可达100毫米；提高阻力能改善力实现并停止位移增长，而振动与力跟踪误差无稳定关联。研究揭示了非刚性底座对接触任务的影响，并强调联合考察力、运动和振动的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile robot manipulators extend contact-task capability beyond the workspace of fixed robot installations, but their bases must also sustain the forces generated by the task. On lightweight platforms, base motion and support compliance can change the force and motion realised at the workpiece. How these non-rigid base effects manifest during sustained contact remains insufficiently characterised. This paper investigates non-rigid base effects in mobile robot manipulators through a sanding case study combining exploratory simulation with experiments on two lightweight, unactuated wheeled testbeds. Joint measurements of contact force, tool motion, and base vibration show that sustained contact coexisted with substantial task error: under low base-ground resistance, only 54-70% of a 100 N command was realised, with tool-centre-point errors reaching 100 mm. Increasing base-ground resistance during contact improved force realisation and arrested further tool displacement, while base vibration did not vary consistently with force-tracking error in the tested conditions. These observations illustrate how non-rigid base behaviour can affect contact-task execution and highlight the value of examining force, motion, and vibration together when characterising lightweight mobile manipulation.

papers.authors: Haowen Lai, Zhiwei Zheng, Mingmin Zhao
papers.evidence: 从雷达观测构建可查询的三维场景几何表示
papers.tldr: 毫米波雷达虽能恢复场景几何并识别预设类别，却难以关联多视角观测中的同一位置，因此无法支持开放式语言查询。TextRadar从全景雷达观测构建场景级三维占据—语言场，在表面位置编码多尺度语言特征，并以单帧蒸馏模型预测距离与对齐特征，结合雷达位姿完成跨帧注册。约两万条、七栋建筑的实验实现自然语言查询和无提示语义可视化，概念迁移在结构、材料和人体姿态上优于颜色及印刷文字。该方法展示了仅依赖雷达构建可查询场景语义表示的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Radar systems can recover scene geometry and recognize predefined categories, but these outputs do not provide a persistent spatial representation for open-ended language queries. Such queries require linking observations from different viewpoints to the same physical locations. We present TextRadar, a framework that constructs a scene-level 3D occupancy-language field from panoramic radar observations. The field combines occupancy with scale-dependent language features at surface locations, allowing the reconstructed scene to be queried with new descriptions. A single-frame radar distillation model predicts aligned ranges and language features from each radar observation. Using radar-estimated poses, we register these predictions to reconstruct the field from radar alone in a new scene. Experiments on approximately 20k synchronized observations across seven buildings demonstrate scene-level natural-language querying and prompt-free semantic visualization. Analysis of camera-to-radar concept transferability shows stronger agreement for structures, materials, and human poses than for colors and printed text.

papers.title_en: Can One Hear Geometry? Gauge-Invariant Spectral Descriptors for Text-to-B-rep Retrieval
papers.authors: Hongzhu Yi, Hao Liu, Tao Yu, Tiankun Yang, Yujia Yang, Zhenghao Zhang, Tianyu Zong, Zhenyu Guan, Bingkang Shi, Haopeng Jin, Yuanxiang Wang, Zhongtian Luo, Jungang Xu
papers.evidence: 通过几何等价类和谱不变量处理三维形状表征
papers.tldr: 文本描述关注形体的内在几何，但B-rep还会随姿态、尺度及边界编码约定变化，造成跨模态检索的表示鸿沟。本文先以几何等价类和谱不变量消除这些歧义，再对截面区域、轮廓边界与拉伸深度构造统一描述符。方法显式处理平移、旋转、反射、均匀缩放和轮廓重编号。在公开基准上，其各项评测指标的召回表现均达到当前最佳，为精确几何与文本对齐提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-3D solid retrieval faces a fundamental representation gap: while natural language describes intrinsic shapes, Boundary Representation (B-rep) entangles precise geometry with arbitrary variations in pose, scale, and boundary encoding conventions. Existing methods either discretize B-reps at the cost of analytic precision, or learn features from topological graphs without explicit invariance guarantees. We propose a text-to-B-rep retrieval framework based on geometric equivalence classes and spectral invariants, mathematically eliminating representation ambiguities prior to cross-modal alignment. Formalizing translation, rotation, reflection, uniform scaling, and contour re-indexing via group actions, we exploit the planar-profile-and-extrusion structure of engineering solids to construct a unified spectral descriptor across cross-sectional regions, contour boundaries, and extrusion depths. On public benchmarks, our method achieves state-of-the-art recall performance across all evaluation metrics.

papers.title_en: ClusterSplat: Semantic Cluster Selection for 3D Visual Grounding in Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Jaesung Lee, Hyeontaek Hwang, Gabriel Manalu, Daeyoung Kim
papers.evidence: 进行三维高斯场景的实例感知语义簇选择
papers.tldr: 在3D高斯泼溅场景中，视觉指代需要同时输出二维渲染掩码与明确的三维高斯目标；现有方法依赖相关性分数阈值或比例筛选，易受场景和文本提示差异影响。ClusterSplat将目标选择改为场景自适应候选簇的选择，并用查询条件评分器直接选簇、生成二维掩码。实验在ScanRefer、细粒度Ref-LERF及ScanNet v2类别查询上取得多项领先结果，显示簇级选择更稳定有效。
papers.abstract_en: We study 3D visual grounding in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), where a referring expression should identify a target object as both a rendered 2D mask and a set of explicit 3D Gaussians. Prior methods typically extract 3D targets by applying heuristic thresholding or top-ratio filtering to dense primitive-level relevance scores. However, these scores often vary substantially across scenes and prompts, making such heuristics sensitive and leading to unstable targeting. ClusterSplat addresses this by reframing 3D target selection as cluster-level selection over scene-adaptive candidates. The method first learns instance-aware Gaussian features, forms feature-aware seed voxels, and merges neighboring seed voxels when a description-length criterion decreases, producing a scene-specific set of cluster candidates. Given a referring expression, a query-conditioned cluster scorer ranks the cluster candidates with a lightweight MLP, and the selected cluster directly defines the explicit 3D target while its cluster score is rendered for the 2D mask. On ScanRefer, ClusterSplat achieves the best rendered 2D segmentation and explicit 3D target metrics among the compared 3DGS baselines. It also obtains the best average Ref-LERF scores, supporting the same trend under fine-grained referring descriptions. On ScanNet v2 class name queries, ClusterSplat achieves the strongest rendered 2D results and the highest 3D matching accuracy, while maintaining competitive 3D IoU. Our project page is available at https://jaesung8.github.io/clustersplat/ .

papers.title_en: RoSAMDepth: Robust Self-supervised Depth Estimation Leveraging Segment Anything Model
papers.authors: Xuanang Gao, Zhiwei Ning, Gengming Zhang, Jiaxi Cao, Runze Yang, Zhonglong Zheng, Jie Yang, Rong Xiao, Wei Liu
papers.evidence: 自监督图像深度估计并融入对象级分割先验
papers.tldr: 鲁棒深度估计需要在多样环境中保持预测质量，但忽略物体级信息的自监督方法，容易产生物体内部深度偏差，并在恶劣条件下出现模糊。RoSAMDepth借助分割一切模型（SAM）的物体先验，从特征表征、区域平滑约束和监督可靠性三方面改进深度学习。实验覆盖多个数据集及多种天气条件，结果显示预测更清晰、准确，且持续优于先进方法。该框架说明物体级先验有助于提升复杂环境下自监督深度估计的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Robust depth estimation aims to maintain high-quality depths across diverse conditions. However, most existing methods estimate depth without taking into account the object-level information. As a result, the predicted depth may easily deviate within objects and become blurred under adverse conditions. To overcome this weakness, we propose RoSAMDepth, a novel framework that can assist robust self-supervised depth estimation in leveraging rich and diverse object-level priors from the Segment Anything Model (SAM). We focus on incorporating object-level information across three key aspects: a segment-guided representation contrasting method that injects object-level awareness into the feature representation space; an adaptive regional outlier masking strategy combined with a regional Gaussian likelihood loss that enforces regional depth smoothness; and an object-level reliability estimation strategy that mitigates the influence of unreliable supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse weather conditions demonstrate that our method produces sharper, more accurate depth predictions, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/xagao/RoSAMDepth.
